definitions.explanation: An approximate calculation of the cost, quantity, or time required for something, often provided before work begins.

examples.japanese: {見積|みつも}もりは{無料|むりょう}ですか？
{修理|しゅうり}の{見積|みつも}もりを{出|だ}してもらった。
examples.english: I got an estimate for the repair.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{見積|みつも}もりが{予算|よさん}を{大|おお}きく{超|こ}えてしまった。
examples.english: The construction estimate greatly exceeded the budget.

notes:
{見積|みつも}もり refers to a preliminary calculation of cost, time, or quantity, typically provided before work begins. Very common in business contexts for price quotations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見積|みつも}もりを{取|と}る: to get an estimate (from a company)
- {見積|みつも}もりを{出|だ}す: to provide an estimate
- {見積|みつも}もりを{依頼|いらい}する: to request an estimate
- {見積|みつも}もり{書|しょ}: written estimate, quotation document
- {見積|みつも}もり{金額|きんがく}: estimated amount

USAGE:
In business, it is standard practice to request a {見積|みつも}もり before committing to a purchase or service. The expression {見積|みつも}もりは{無料|むりょう}ですか ("Is the estimate free?") is very common.

RELATED WORDS:
- {見積|みつも}もる: to estimate (verb form)
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}: invoice (issued after work is done)
- {予算|よさん}: budget
